Sonakshi Sinha and Zaheer Iqbal's Film 'Tu Hai Meri Kiran' Trailer Released

The trailer for the film 'Tu Hai Meri Kiran', starring Sonakshi Sinha and Zaheer Iqbal, has been released. The film is described as a story of one-sided love and obsession, with Zaheer Iqbal portraying a villainous role. Viewers have reacted with surprise and admiration, with some comparing it to Shah Rukh Khan's film 'Darr'. This marks the first time Sinha and Iqbal will share the screen together after their reported marriage.
